suppression.why: iNaturalist obscures this taxon by default (taxon_geoprivacy)
Nest sites are protected under the Eagle Act; sightings cluster at nests.
Hunted on crossing the park boundary; a public sighting map is a targeting aid. Legal status flips between states and years; treated as sensitive everywhere.
Repeatedly listed and delisted; poaching and conflict-removal pressure. Coarse cells keep presence visible without den-scale precision.

notes.obscured: coordinates fuzzed by the source for sensitive taxa; counted, never mapped
notes.names: subspecies collapsed to species; GBIF backbone spellings mapped to iNaturalist's (config/taxonomy.toml)
